MiDn_contribution_definition: Sum per-query MiD/(all_negative_groups * negative_queries_in_its_group) inside each disjoint sign/saturation cell; denominators remain those of the complete negative band. These four contributions sum to original MiDn.
empty_cells: CSV empty values mean undefined, never zero
conditional_metrics: Cell/group quantities do not equal the original whole-band macro score; conditional model sign subsets differ. Use paired_sign_cells for matched-query comparisons.
